lines.text: Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in the four hundred and eightieth year after Israel left Egypt.
The temple was built with stones cut at the quarry, so no iron tool was heard in it.
God told Solomon that if he kept all His commandments, God would fulfill the promise He made to Moses.
Solomon made two cherubim of cedar for the inner sanctuary, where the ark of the covenant would be set.
The foundation was laid in Solomon's fourth year, and the temple was finished in the eleventh year in seven years.
